roleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, E-commerce Fulfilment Software
jobDescription: The e-commerce fulfilment software vendor ingests order, inventory and shipment feeds from hundreds of merchants. The Data Quality Engineer owns merchant feed quality end-to-end, decides which feed validations block onboarding, leads the merchant data quality forum, and is accountable to the VP of data for the quality of the feeds that drive fulfilment.
requirements: Owns merchant feed quality end-to-end and decides which feed validations block merchant onboarding.
Builds and maintains the feed validation service and the quality scorecards per merchant.
Leads the monthly merchant data quality forum with onboarding and support and records decisions.
Coordinates validation changes with the onboarding and platform teams and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents validation definitions, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release.

evidence.text: Owned merchant feed quality for the fulfilment platform for three years as the named owner in the data ownership register, deciding which feed validations were blocking for onboarding and signing off each validation release myself.
Built and maintained the feed validation service (Kotlin, deployed with the ingestion stack) and the per-merchant quality scorecards used by onboarding and support.
Led the monthly merchant data quality forum with the onboarding and support leads, deciding the quality thresholds for new merchant tiers and recording the decisions in the forum notes.

Coordinated validation changes with the onboarding and platform teams through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the ingestion stack and onboarding owned merchant communication while I owned the validations.
Responsibilities included feed quality ownership, blocking-validation decisions, validation-service development, scorecards and the quality forum over about three years.

Work sample: the data ownership register entry naming the candidate as owner, the validation release log with the candidate's sign-offs and one forum note, with the service's release identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former VP of data: confirmed the candidate owned merchant feed quality, decided blocking validations and led the quality forum; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for a technical session on the validation service; notice period is two months.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each validation release are only partly documented in the release log.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented for the validations; do not extend it to the ingestion stack or merchant communication, which other teams owned.
